create_CRRAgent: create a CRRAgent instance with observation and action shapes for continuous control reinforcement learning
build_Actor_network: build an Actor neural network that outputs a truncated normal policy distribution over actions
build_Critic_network: build a Critic network with twin Q-networks for estimating state-action value functions
run_CRRAgent_update: run the CRRAgent update loop to train both actor and critic on a replay batch
test_CRRAgent_act: test the CRRAgent act method to sample actions from the policy given an observation
